risks.title: REIT Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulatory requirements as a REIT, including the obligation to distribute at least 90% of its annual taxable income. Non-compliance may result in loss of REIT status and federal, state and local taxation.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company invests in riskier assets, including non-agency mortgages, collateralized loan obligations (CLOs), commercial loans and non-investment grade securities. These assets are sensitive to payment defaults and credit market fluctuations.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in interest rates, credit spreads, real estate asset prices and overall market volatility. These factors directly impact the value of the investment portfolio and dividend distribution capacity.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive alternative investment and asset management market, where other fund managers and REITs target the same asset classes and investment opportunities.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be affected by geopolitical events, including changes in monetary policy, housing policy adjustments and international credit crises that influence financial markets.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Although the company relies on Ellington's and Longbridge's cybersecurity processes integrated into their risk management programs, cyberattacks could compromise customer data, financial information and critical operational systems.

risks.title: Manager Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is managed by Ellington Management, a subsidiary of Ellington. The manager has no employees of its own and relies entirely on Ellington employees for investment strategy, risk management and day-to-day operations.
